an4.183:3.3: Brahmin, I don’t say that everything you have heard should be spoken;
an4.183:3.4: Nor do I say, brahmin, that nothing you have heard should be spoken;
an4.183:3.5: Brahmin, I don’t say that everything you have thought should be spoken;
an4.183:3.6: Nor do I say, brahmin, that nothing you have thought should be spoken;
an4.183:3.7: Brahmin, I don’t say that everything you have known should be spoken;
an4.183:3.8: Nor do I say, brahmin, that nothing you have known should be spoken.
an4.183:5.1: For brahmin, when talking about what you’ve heard, unskillful qualities grow while skillful qualities decline. I say that what has been heard in that way should not be spoken.
an4.183:5.2: But brahmin, when not talking about other things you’ve heard, skillful qualities decline while unskillful qualities grow. I say that what has been heard in that way should be spoken.
an4.183:6.1: For brahmin, when talking about what you’ve thought, unskillful qualities grow while skillful qualities decline. I say that what has been thought in that way should not be spoken.
an4.183:6.2: But brahmin, when not talking about other things you’ve thought, skillful qualities decline while unskillful qualities grow. I say that what has been thought in that way should be spoken.
an4.183:7.1: For brahmin, when talking about what you’ve known, unskillful qualities grow while skillful qualities decline. I say that what has been known in that way should not be spoken.
an4.183:7.2: But brahmin, when not talking about other things you’ve known, skillful qualities decline while unskillful qualities grow. I say that what has been known in that way should be spoken.”
